extracted.name: Lemon lavender cookies
extracted.description: These are my favorite cookies right now! I love the lavender taste with a little lemon kick in the background
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 375 grease cookie sheets or line with parchment paper
Combine flour, salt, baking powder, and baking soda in a bowl
In a separate bowl cream butter and sugar till combined
Beat in eggs vanilla extract, lavender extract and lavender syrup, lemon juice till fluffy
Combine the dry and the wet mixtures
Using a cookie scoop (or hands) Roll out 1/2 inch balls
